form.barLabel: Go to the next step or send the request
form.documentsOpen: Attach quotations or documents, or suggest a supplier
form.fixRule: Attach what rule {rule} asks for under {part}
form.notFound: This request was not found, or it is not yours. Choose a request type to start a new request

closedBy.SENT: This request was already sent elsewhere, so it can no longer be changed on this page, and what you changed here since the draft was last saved is not saved
closedBy.CANCELLED: This request was already cancelled elsewhere, so it can no longer be changed on this page, and what you changed here since the draft was last saved is not saved. If you still need it, start a new request from Request types
closedBy.NOT_FOUND: This request is no longer found, so it can no longer be changed on this page, and what you changed here since the draft was last saved is not saved. Your drafts and returned requests are on Request types
closedBy.FORBIDDEN: This account can no longer change this request, and what you changed here since the draft was last saved is not saved. If you should be able to change it, ask your organization's administrator to check your account's role
closedBy.ELSEWHERE: This request was already sent or cancelled elsewhere, so it can no longer be changed on this page, and what you changed here since the draft was last saved is not saved

form.sessionEnded: Your session has ended, so this was not done. Close this page and open Request from the menu in the LINE chat again. A draft saved before is under Your drafts and returned requests
